name: Política Nacional de Ciberseguridad 2023-2028 (Decreto Supremo N° 164/2023)
description: Política Nacional de Ciberseguridad 2023-2028 (Decreto Supremo N° 164/2023, published December 4, 2023). Chile's national cybersecurity strategy defining objectives across resilient infrastructure, citizen rights in cyberspace, cybersecurity culture, industrial/research development, and international governance under Law No. 21.663 (Ley Marco sobre Ciberseguridad).
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Gobierno de Chile (gob.cl) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Gobierno de Chile (gob.cl).
